machine: Apple M1 Pro (10 CPU cores, 16 GB unified memory), macOS 27.0.1

ddpm.what: DDPM, 8,000 training steps (Diffusion from zero), ancestral DDPM sampler, 250 steps, no guidance

ddim.what: the same 8,000-step model, DDIM, 10 steps, no guidance

flow.what: flow matching, 4,000 steps (Flow lab), Euler 50 steps, no guidance (s = 1)

flow_g15.what: the same flow model, Euler 50 steps, guidance s = 1.5 (the Flow lab's best FD)

flow_g4.what: the same flow model, Euler 50 steps, strong guidance s = 4

vae.what: 16-d VAE (beta 1, Latent lab), 10,000 codes from N(0, I) decoded

real.what: 10,000 real training images (the first 10,000 of the train split: the setup's real-vs-real floor set)

half.what: constructed: 10,000 real training images from 5 of the 10 classes only (perfect images, half the variety)
